claim: Larger model scale is associated with lower measured depth of unlearning erasure, attributed to greater model capacity causing less representational shift from training data differences.
falsifier: On a family of models of different sizes, apply the same unlearning method and compute the activation-patching-based depth score; verify that the score decreases with scale.

conditions: unlearning methods applied to models of varying scale
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported models and unlearning configurations; transfer beyond them is unestablished.

title: Increase in model scale–measured depth of erasure principle
